name: @red-cup-engineering/gaming
description: Gaming — concurrent game systems (CGS) operationalized as one package downstream of animating and upstream of computing: algebra carriers (Player/Opponent polarity, polarized prime event structures, strategies, ludics loci and designs, interaction as the knowledge-join), topology closure/settling, linear-logic proof, causal/spatial geometry, dynamics analysis, operational game computers, and charge-faithful codecs. Each former game-* package is now a module subpath. A game is a configuration of animating handedness over the relating substrate.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json && node copy-dist-assets.mjs && chmod +x dist/scripts/*.mjs
scripts.rebuild: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build
